title: Unused Roadside Call Credit on Life-of-Tread Cancellations
content:
For a holder's cancellation of a Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate refunded on the Life-of-Tread cancellation refund, the Life-of-Tread unused-call credit applies.

**Life-of-Tread unused-call credit.** When the certificate still has roadside calls remaining and no roadside service entry was ever booked on it, each remaining call is credited at 10 USD and the credit is added to the Life-of-Tread cancellation refund; when calls remain and at least one roadside service entry was booked, each remaining call is credited at 5 USD and added the same way; with no call remaining there is no credit. The calls themselves still lapse with the certificate.

| Roadside calls remaining | Roadside service entries ever booked on the certificate | Credit added to the refund |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | none | 10.00 per remaining call |
| one or more | one or more | 5.00 per remaining call |
| none | any | none |

*Hypothetical cases.* A certificate with all 4 calls remaining and no roadside service ever booked: credit 40.00. A certificate with 2 calls remaining after two dispatched services: credit 10.00. A certificate with no call remaining: no credit.
